purpose: Audit a pure RealLive VM plus semantic/syscall translation into reusable CrySirror APIs; not a hosted runtime audit
audit_scope: Pinned source provenance and selected/reference SHA256 verification
Current crate import/module and forbidden frame publication checks
Independent engine media behavior; native opening validation remains separate
vm_only_ownership: bytecode parsing and target offset mapping
read flags and VM savepoint banks/call stack
event_boundary: All native engine operations are pending Command/Text events until successful CrySirror API acknowledgement; no native rendering/text/audio implementation is linked

shared_api_routes.state_owner: crysirror-scene::canvas::CanvasSystem; logical draw-node snapshots become retained Layer nodes

shared_api_routes.native_operation: Text positions, styling and scalar reveal
shared_api_routes.engine_api: Paint::GlyphRun / GlyphReveal / engine query and complete_reveal
shared_api_routes.state_owner: shared retained layers and text glyph cache; native grid/markup policy stays adapter
shared_api_routes.independent_api: Ordinary Layer paint and shared TextSystem glyph metrics

shared_api_routes.engine_api: UiCommand widget creation/events and engine queries
AudioRequest and shared native format sources
MediaRequest / MediaInfo; media image resource used by an ordinary Layer
shared_api_routes.independent_api: Media.play / Media.stop / Media.status and direct Rust MediaManager API

shared_api_routes.native_operation: Resource lookup and script-visible state queries
shared_api_routes.state_owner: engine capabilities and shared logical state; native naming policy remains adapter

limitations: Whole-track audio bounded at 16Mi i16 samples; not long-track streaming
Decoded image/PTS fidelity belongs to existing codec; count is not a source every-frame coverage claim
Virtual vs real time result is not a frame-rate benchmark

native_opening_profile.state: root validation in progress; no completion asserted by this source audit
native_opening_profile.not_evidence: Old hosted runtime screenshots or old hosted save results do not validate this API bridge

unsupported_or_unproven: Original native save-file import/export through the adapter
Whole VM/runtime snapshots with this adapter or active media
DLL emulation and arbitrary native host operations
All RealLive opcode/module variants, effects, layouts and resource variants
Complete-game execution and cross-platform device behavior
Long-track streaming media audio, media seek/pause
Isolated canvas opacity and partial replacement requiring a genuine engine render-target API
non_claims: 90 upstream reference source files are hashed, not claimed to be translated or mapped
No RealLive private screen buffer/painter/old Engine/System/Graphics/Sound/Movie was restored
Shared services have no dependency on crysirror-reallive; the dependency direction is adapter to engine
This audit does not certify the entire transitive dependency graph as interpreter-free; existing codecs may share other source libraries without hosting their engines
